name: com.quasslabs/api
title: QuassLabs API
description: 30+ deterministic dev and delivery tools: linting, metrics, diagrams, model advice, AI-text checks.

headers.name: Authorization
headers.description: Bearer qlk_... API key from https://quasslabs.com/api, or from the account tool's signup action. Not needed for tools/list, the account tool's signup and checkout_status actions, or the six free tools (rate-limited per network).

io.modelcontextprotocol.registry/publish.auth: Bearer qlk_* API key required for tools/call. initialize, tools/list and ping are unauthenticated so the catalog is discoverable without credentials. OAuth 2.1 deferred (only the Anthropic Connectors Directory requires it).
io.modelcontextprotocol.registry/publish.namespaceVerification: com.quasslabs/* is granted by DNS verification of the apex quasslabs.com, not api.quasslabs.com - the registry derives the namespace from the reverse-DNS of the verified domain.
io.modelcontextprotocol.registry/publish.toolCount: 33. compress is temporarily disabled and hidden from tools/list; tools/list always shows exactly what is callable right now.
